scope: 104 legacy KB entries plus a separate mapping of 13 hardcoded FAQ entries to the 77 articles observed in targeted MCP probes. These are not 117 distinct intents.
limitations: Observed catalog is not a certified complete help-center inventory.
No match means not found in these probes, not definitive product capability loss.
Core-equivalent means the central intent has corresponding source guidance, not all claims are current or that the model answered correctly.
No historic policy, country count, phone number or fee is restored automatically.

All same-ID captured contents have now been compared: 21 normalized text matches, 39 core-equivalent translations and five changed/partial entries. This is not a fresh help-center or product-policy validation.
Conflicts between captured articles can exist even when each article preserves legacy wording.
